newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Most basis offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Most basis offers unchanged.

text.p: Most basis offers in cash soymeal markets were unchanged and trade was minimal as buyers were sidelined by a rally in CBOT prices, dealers said.
"I'm sure this rally is going to slow up demand," said one dealer from the southeast.
Early Tuesday, CBOT August soymeal climbed to the highest level since June 13, and other months were $4.00 to $7.00 per ton higher.
Dealers said that although soymeal in Illinois rail markets was offered at $32.00 per ton over August futures, there were trades at $26.00 and $27.00 per ton basis August.
Many Midwest soybean crushers are planning downtime during August, and those planned production cut-backs continued to support the soymeal basis, dealers said.
Although soymeal sales were slow early Tuesday, soybean crushers reported active sales of old crop soybeans.
